name: dial
title: Dial
description: Circular numeric control with a tick ring that fills from min to the current value, drag axis, wrap, invert, progress outline, sizes, and label placement. Prefer Slider for a linear track, and Tick Slider for bound labels with a tick gauge.

api.description: Circular numeric control with a tick ring that fills from min to the current value, optional center or edge label, and a moving indicator. Pointer travel raises or lowers the value. wrap spins through a full turn with no origin fill. invert reverses drag so reverse rotation can go negative. progress draws a rotation outline on the face. Prefer Slider for a linear track, and Tick Slider for bound labels with a tick gauge.

props.name: min
props.description: Minimum value.

props.name: max
props.description: Maximum value.

props.name: step
props.description: Increment between committed values. Values of 0 or less fall back to 1.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value. Snapped to step and clamped, or wrapped when wrap is set.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Uncontrolled initial value.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called when a committed value changes.

props.name: wrap
props.description: When true, dragging or stepping past max continues at min, and past min continues at max. Ticks do not fill from an origin unless tickFill is set. Leave false to clamp.

props.name: invert
props.description: Reverse pointer travel and arrow keys. Right and up decrease. Set min below 0 so reverse rotation can go negative.

props.name: dragAxis
props.description: Pointer axis that changes the value. all maps right and up to increase, left and down to decrease, and diagonals combine. horizontal uses only left and right. vertical uses only up and down. The indicator still travels around the ring.

props.name: startAngle
props.description: Ring heading in degrees clockwise from the top. Gauge min sits here when min is 0 or greater. When min is below 0 and max is above 0, value 0 sits here.

props.name: sweep
props.description: How much of the ring the range uses. 360 is a full ring. Use less than 360 to keep the ends on distinct points.

props.name: formatValue
props.description: Formats the visible value and aria valuetext. Overrides valueFormat.

props.name: valueFormat
props.description: Built in readout format. number uses step precision. percent shows position across min to max. Ignored when formatValue is set.

props.name: showValue
props.description: Show the formatted value in the center of the ring.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables pointer and keyboard interaction.

props.name: label
props.description: Optional label. Use a short mark for inside, or any copy for an outside edge. An inside label next to a value uses smaller muted type so the value stays primary.

props.name: labelPosition
props.description: Where the label sits. inside places it in the center of the ring. top, bottom, left, and right sit outside the ring.

props.name: labelGap
props.description: Gap between an outside label and the ring. Prefer a kit length token such as calc(4 * var(--spacing-unit)). Ignored when the label is inside.

props.name: size
props.description: Ring diameter and matching tick, thumb, and type sizes. sm is compact, md is the default, lg is a large ring.

props.name: thumb
props.description: Value indicator. dot is a circular thumb on the ring. tick hides the thumb and accents the nearest tick.

props.name: tickCount
props.description: Number of ticks around the ring. Minimum 2.

props.name: showTicks
props.description: Show the tick ring.

props.name: tickFill
props.default: true when wrap is off and min is 0 or greater
props.description: Fill ticks from min to the current value. Defaults to on for a gauge. Off when wrap is set or min is below 0 so the ring has no origin. Set true to force fill.

props.name: tickRadius
props.description: End of each default tick. none is square. full is round.

props.name: thumbRadius
props.description: Corner radius of the dot thumb.

props.name: renderTick
props.type: (tick: { index: number; count: number; active: boolean; filled: boolean; angle: number; value: number }) => React.ReactNode
props.description: Replace each default tick with custom content. filled is true from min to the current value. active is true on the nearest tick when thumb is tick.

props.name: accent
props.description: Fill for the dot thumb and the nearest tick when thumb is tick. Prefer a kit color token.

props.name: tickMuted
props.description: Fill for ticks past the current value. Prefer a kit color token.

props.name: tickFilled
props.description: Fill for ticks from min to the current value. Prefer a kit color token.

props.name: tickActive
props.description: Fill for the nearest tick when thumb is tick. Prefer a kit color token.

props.name: labelColor
props.description: Label text color. Prefer a kit color token.

props.name: valueColor
props.description: Value text color. Prefer a kit color token.

props.name: faceBackground
props.description: Fill behind the ring. Transparent by default.

props.name: faceBorder
props.description: Border color of the ring. Transparent by default.

props.name: progress
props.description: Draw a ring on the face edge from startAngle to the current value. The unused part of the rim stays empty. Ticks inset from that ring so they do not sit on the edge.

props.name: progressColor
props.description: Color of the progress ring. Prefer a kit color token.

props.name: tickWidth
props.description: Tick thickness. Prefer a kit length token.

props.name: tickLength
props.description: Tick length along the radius. Prefer a kit length token.

props.name: thumbSize
props.description: Dot thumb diameter. Prefer a kit length token.

props.name: tickSound
props.description: Play a short tick on each stepped value change while dragging or using the keyboard. Skipped when the document is hidden or reduced motion is preferred.

props.name: scrubSound
props.description: Play a smooth scrub tone while dragging. Pitch follows position and level follows drag speed. Off by default. Stops on release, unmount, or when the document is hidden. Skipped when reduced motion is preferred.

groups.title: Keyboard and accessibility
groups.description: Slider (role="slider"): The face is the slider. Arrow keys step the value. invert flips that direction. Home goes to min. End goes to max, or to the last rest when wrap is set. PageUp and PageDown move by one tenth of the range.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name when label is omitted or is not a string.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: ID of a labeling element. Defaults to the label element when label is set and aria-label is omitted.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional styles on the root.

props.name: style
props.description: Inline styles on the root. Can also override Dial CSS variables directly.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the root element.

groups.title: Tokens
groups.description: Theme defaults live on :root. Override these globally, on a local host, or with the matching appearance props. size remaps diameter, tick, thumb, and type tokens. Prop and style overrides still win.

props.name: --df-dial-size
props.description: Ring diameter for size md.

props.name: --df-dial-size-sm
props.description: Ring diameter for size sm.

props.name: --df-dial-size-lg
props.description: Ring diameter for size lg.

props.name: --df-dial-accent
props.description: Dot thumb fill and default active tick fill.

props.name: --df-dial-tick-muted
props.description: Fill for ticks past the current value.

props.name: --df-dial-tick-filled
props.description: Fill for ticks from min to the current value.

props.name: --df-dial-tick-active
props.description: Nearest tick fill when thumb is tick.

props.name: --df-dial-tick-width
props.description: Tick thickness for size md.

props.name: --df-dial-tick-length
props.description: Tick length for size md.

props.name: --df-dial-tick-radius
props.description: End radius of a custom HTML tick.

props.name: --df-dial-thumb-size
props.description: Dot thumb diameter for size md. The center sits on the tick midpoint. One spacing unit longer so the dot covers the mark.

props.name: --df-dial-thumb-radius
props.description: Dot thumb corner radius.

props.name: --df-dial-face-bg
props.description: Fill inside the ring. Transparent by default so the ticks sit on the page.

props.name: --df-dial-face-fill
props.description: Filled face color. Pass it as faceBackground for a disc behind the ticks.

props.name: --df-dial-face-border
props.description: Ring border color.

props.name: --df-dial-face-border-width
props.description: Ring border width.

props.name: --df-dial-face-radius
props.description: Corner radius of the ring face.

props.name: --df-dial-ring-inset
props.description: Space from the face edge to the outer tick tips when the face is filled or progress is set.

props.name: --df-dial-progress-color
props.description: Progress ring color.

props.name: --df-dial-progress-width
props.description: Progress ring thickness.

props.name: --df-dial-label-color
props.description: Label text color.

props.name: --df-dial-label-font-family
props.description: Label font.

props.name: --df-dial-label-font-weight
props.description: Label weight.

props.name: --df-dial-label-size
props.description: Label type size for size md.

props.name: --df-dial-label-caption-color
props.description: Inside label color when a value is also shown.

props.name: --df-dial-label-caption-size
props.description: Inside label type size when a value is also shown, for size md.

props.name: --df-dial-value-color
props.description: Value text color.

props.name: --df-dial-value-font-family
props.description: Value font.

props.name: --df-dial-value-font-weight
props.description: Value weight.

props.name: --df-dial-value-size
props.description: Value type size for size md.

props.name: --df-dial-label-gap
props.description: Gap between an outside label and the ring. size remaps this. labelGap and style overrides still win.

props.name: --df-dial-center-gap
props.description: Gap between an inside label and the value.

props.name: --df-dial-motion-duration
props.description: Duration for thumb settle, face press, and active tick length.

props.name: --df-dial-motion-ease
props.description: Easing for thumb settle, face press, and active tick length.

props.name: --df-dial-drag-scale
props.description: Face scale while dragging.

props.name: --df-dial-tick-active-grow
props.description: Extra tick length when thumb is tick and the mark is nearest the value.

props.name: --df-dial-label-max-width
props.description: Maximum width of an outside label.
